message: ATHENA 1.2.1 is out — fix any workout's time with a dial, on the finish screen or on any past workout. Plus the custom-exercise equipment list scrolls again on iOS 26, and a rebuilt weight tracker. OUTWORK YESTERDAY.

dispatch.title: New bodies are coming
dispatch.body:
The avatar's been redrawn from scratch — both the men's and the women's figures, front and back. Every muscle is its own panel now, the seams stay sharp when it lights up, and a few muscles that were never separate before finally are: side delts, adductors, abductors, tibialis.

It's on my phone tonight. It'll be in the next update, and it's the whole update — nothing else in it, so it can go out fast.

After that, different bodies to grow into. Same muscles, new skins.

dispatch.title: You can fix the workout time now — it's out
dispatch.body:
Forgot to stop the timer? Or forgot to start it? Tap the duration on the finish screen — or on any past workout — and set it with a dial. Hours and minutes, done.

Someone's friend asked for this on Thursday. Apple waved it through Saturday afternoon — update and it's yours.

Also in it: the equipment list when you build a custom exercise wouldn't scroll to the bottom on iOS 26 — a friend of a friend caught that one, fixed. The weight tracker is rebuilt around start → goal. And your themes live on your Profile now instead of three taps deep in Settings.

If ATHENA's earned a rating, this is a good moment for it.

dispatch.title: Steal your friend's workout
dispatch.body:
Tap any workout in the Friends feed and the whole thing opens — every exercise, every set, every weight, supersets included. One button turns it into your own routine.

It copies in your units, so their kg lands as your lb.

And if you'd rather your numbers stayed yours: Settings → Share workout details turns the detail off. Friends still see that you trained, just not what you lifted.

dispatch.title: Tell me what to build
dispatch.body:
I read every email that comes through Send Feedback. Not a support team — me, usually at night.

A good amount of what's already in ATHENA is here because somebody asked for it. So if something's missing, or something annoys you every single time you open the app, that's genuinely the most useful thing you can send me. Small stuff counts — a button in the wrong place is a real problem.

We're small enough right now that one person's idea can actually change the app. That stops being true at some point. Use it while it's true.

Dispatch is one-way on purpose, so it lands in my inbox instead. Tell me what you'd build and I'll tell you straight whether I can.

dispatch.title: 100 of you
dispatch.body:
ATHENA just passed 100 people. By App Store standards that's nothing. To me it's absurd — I build this alone, in the evenings, and a few weeks ago it was me and a handful of friends.

There's no marketing engine behind this. I tried paid ads and turned them off; they weren't working. Everyone here found it because somebody posted about it, or told someone at the gym.

So if ATHENA's earned it, send it to one person who lifts. One. That's the whole ask, and it genuinely is how this grows.

dispatch.title: What I'm building next
dispatch.body:
More avatars — the redraw above ships next, then different bodies to grow into, not just different colours. Refer a friend: give a month, get a month. And a rebuilt first run, so new people reach the part that actually hooks faster.

No dates on any of it. I'd rather ship one thing properly than promise five.
